evals.prompt: 这个仓库的 `license-header` CI job 一直失败。请排查并修复，让检查通过。仓库在 `{repo}`。不要修改 generated/、vendor/、README.md、data.json 和 LICENSE 的内容；如果某些文件确实不该检查，请在配置里说明原因，不要放宽到跳过正常源码。
evals.expected_output: `license-eye header check` exits 0; normal source/workflow files gain MIT headers; generated, vendor, README, data.json and LICENSE remain unchanged; CI workflow still pins the action and uses check mode.
expectations: Final license-eye header check exits 0
Every non-excluded source, test, script and workflow file has an MIT header
scripts/release.sh keeps its shebang on line 1 and places the header after it
LICENSE, README.md, data.json, generated/bundle.js and vendor/lib.js are unchanged
The config still targets MIT and was not loosened to skip src/tests/scripts/.github
The CI workflow still contains a pinned check-mode header gate

evals.prompt: 请给这个仓库接入 license header 检查，并加一个 GitHub Actions 门禁。项目使用 MIT 许可证，版权方 Beta Inc。仓库在 `{repo}`。不要修改 LICENSE、data/config.json 和 generated/ 的内容。
evals.expected_output: A .licenserc.yaml for MIT / Beta Inc exists; source files gain headers; a pinned GitHub Actions workflow uses check mode; LICENSE, JSON and generated files are unchanged; header check exits 0.
expectations: A .licenserc.yaml exists and configures MIT for Beta Inc
Final license-eye header check exits 0
The JavaScript source files have MIT headers for Beta Inc
LICENSE, data/config.json and generated/schema.js are unchanged
A GitHub Actions workflow gates on header check with a pinned license-eye setup
The config does not skip the source files

evals.prompt: 这个仓库的 license header 检查很奇怪：有些文件明明有头，CI 还是报错。请查清楚原因并修好，让检查通过。仓库在 `{repo}`。不要修改 src/good.go、README.md 和 LICENSE；不要通过把失败文件加进忽略列表来绕过检查。
evals.expected_output: Header check exits 0; good.go is unchanged; typo, late, missing and wrong-owner files each end with exactly one correct Apache header; the config is not loosened to ignore the failing sources.
expectations: Final license-eye header check exits 0
LICENSE, README.md and src/good.go are unchanged
src/typo.go has exactly one Apache header with the correct LICENSE-2.0 URL
src/late.go ends with exactly one Apache header (moved or threshold raised), not a duplicate
src/missing.go gained exactly one Apache header
src/wrong_owner.go has exactly one Apache header with Acme Corp and no Other Corp
The config still targets Apache-2.0 and was not loosened to ignore the failing sources

evals.prompt: 请给这个 Go 项目接入依赖许可证检查，并生成一个可提交的 LICENSE 摘要，同时把它加进 CI。项目主许可证是 Apache-2.0，版权方 Acme Corp。仓库在 `{repo}`。不要修改 main.go 和 go.mod。

expectations: The config declares go.mod in dependency.files
Final license-eye dependency check exits 0
Final license-eye header check still exits 0
A generated LICENSE summary contains the project Apache license and the uuid BSD-3-Clause dependency
CI has a pinned dependency-license check job with Go setup in the same job
main.go, go.mod and go.sum are unchanged
